text: She just scared us a lot.

text: She used to do that shit.

text: You know how embarrassing that is?
To get pumped by a four-foot-eight Asian woman at the fucking mall.

text: Get out of the goddamn foot locker.
Get out of the foot locker.

text: I used to cry and tell my mom, I have kids, I'm never gonna do it, you do it for me.
zh: 我以前一边哭一边跟我妈说，我以后有了孩子，绝不这么干，你替我干了吧。
zh_hant: 我以前一邊哭一邊跟我媽說，我以後有了孩子，絕不這麼幹，你替我幹了吧。

text: And my mom looked at me, I swear to God, she put her hand on my shoulder.
zh: 我妈看着我，我发誓，她把手搭在我肩上。

zh: 她说：“约瑟夫，答应我，好吗？
